name: source_verified_v1

selection_policy.code2inv: 30 selected from all 133 numbered C instances, seed 1729, round-robin syntactic strata, one per constant-normalized AST family; no solver/model outcomes consulted.
selection_policy.svcomp: 12 predeclared named tasks covering machine arithmetic, nondeterminism, branching, nonlinear updates, nested loops, arrays and a published negative control.
selection_policy.caveat: AST family fingerprints catch some near-duplicates, not semantic equivalence or training contamination. Do not claim 42 independent algorithms.
